texts.zh:
[from.GetName]异常的黑云事实上是某种大型食肉昆虫的密集虫群。

这些长着翅膀的掠食者在岩石裂缝中筑巢，每天定时从中倾巢而出，吞吃星球表面所剩无几的有机物。

得益于强大的新陈代谢可以在在进食时逆转细胞衰变，使得这些节肢动物只要定期消耗营养就能无限期地延长寿命。
texts.en:
The unusual black clouds on [from.GetName] are actually dense swarms of large carnivorous insects.

These winged predators nest in rock fissures and emerge once daily to devour any scant organic matter available on the planet's surface.

Thanks to a potent metabolism which reverses cell decay upon feeding, these arthropods can prolong their lifespan indefinitely, as long as nutrients are consumed regularly.

texts.zh: 在田野调查分析的过程中，[Leader.GetName]的[Leader.Species.GetHandName]被其中的一个标本咬伤，下a额触发了一种显著的代谢响应。这种独特的物种身上还有很多关于有机细胞再生能力的知识可以学习。
texts.en: During fieldwork analysis, [Leader.GetName]'s [Leader.Species.GetHandName] was bitten by one of the specimens, triggering a remarkable metabolic response. This unique species has much to teach us about the regenerative capacities of organic cells.
